wizard.label: Steps to put the contract into force

USB_TOKEN.name: USB token
USB_TOKEN.description: Plug the token into this computer and enter the PIN. Signing software must be installed.
USB_TOKEN.description_certified: Plug the token into this computer and enter the PIN. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

VNPT_SMARTCA.name: VNPT SmartCA
VNPT_SMARTCA.description_certified: Confirm in the phone app. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

VIETTEL_MYSIGN.name: Viettel MySign
VIETTEL_MYSIGN.description_certified: Confirm in the phone app. Certificate: {{holder}}, expires {{expiry}}.

IMAGE.name: Signature image
IMAGE.description: Draw a signature image on the page. There is no digital signature, so it cannot be verified.
IMAGE.blocked: Not available for this contract: it only draws an image on the page, carries no digital signature, has no legal value and cannot be verified.

errors.NOT_YOUR_TURN: It is not your turn to sign.
errors.IMAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: This contract requires a digital signature; a signature image cannot be used.
errors.SIGNING_ALREADY_STARTED: Someone has already signed, so this can no longer be changed.
errors.UNKNOWN: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.SIGNATURE_PROVIDER_ERROR: The signing provider has not returned valid evidence. Signing remains incomplete.
errors.EXTRACTION_CONFIG_INVALID: Invalid extraction configuration. Check the server provider, model and key.
errors.GEMINI_UNAVAILABLE: Document reading did not respond. Retry; your contract has not changed.
errors.GEMINI_RATE_LIMIT: Gemini quota reached. Wait or check the project quota and retry.
errors.GEMINI_AUTH_FAILED: Google denied server access. Check the API key and project permissions.
errors.GEMINI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The configured Gemini model is unavailable. Select an accessible model on the server.
errors.GEMINI_INVALID_RESPONSE: AI output is incomplete or invalid. Retry or review the document.
errors.GEMINI_DOCUMENT_LIMIT: AI currently accepts PDF files up to 10 MB and 40 pages.
errors.GEMINI_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED: Upload and save an actual contract file before using AI.
errors.GEMINI_BUSY: Too many documents are being read. Retry shortly.
errors.SLOT_REQUIRED: Every signer needs a valid signature area on the document.
errors.SLOT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: A signature area is outside its page or has invalid dimensions.
errors.SLOT_OVER_TEXT: A signature area covers contract text. Move it to blank space.
errors.SLOT_OVERLAP: Signature areas overlap. Give each signer a separate area.
errors.SIGNER_DOCUMENT_MISMATCH: The signer does not match the printed name/party. Check the signer list or regenerate the document.
errors.SLOT_WRONG_SIGNER_AREA: The box is outside this signer’s printed area. Select the correct area or use the suggestion.

slot.aria: Signature slot {{stepNo}}, {{party}}. Use the arrow keys to move, Shift plus arrow to resize, Delete to remove.

list.title: Signature slots
list.position: Page {{page}} · {{top}} mm from top, {{left}} mm from left · size {{width}}×{{height}} mm

positions.pdfError: Page image could not load. Reload before placing signature areas.
positions.reviewNotice: Review the document and signature area before sending the signing request.
positions.mismatch: No matching printed signing area for: {{names}}
positions.missingPrintedName: The name or party does not match a printed area in the PDF.
positions.mismatchSummary: The signer list does not match the document
positions.unconfiguredShort: Printed names missing from the signer list: {{names}}.

preview.title: Preview of the signed document
preview.hint: The signatures and seals are illustrations placed in the signing boxes you configured. Each seal is upright and covers about one third of the signature on its left, as Decree 30/2020/ND-CP requires. Check before saving.

clause.TOTAL_VALUE: The total contract value is <mark>{{value}}</mark>, paid in {{milestones}} milestones.
clause.LATE_PENALTY: Late delivery is penalised at <mark>{{rate}}% of the milestone value per day</mark>, with a total penalty of no more than <mark>{{cap}}% of the milestone value</mark>.
clause.APPROVALS: Each payment needs the approval of <mark>{{approvers}} buyer role(s)</mark>.

ambiguity.title: MS{{no}}: the contract only says "after {{months}} months of warranty"
ambiguity.label: MS{{no}} due date

total.title: Sum of milestones
total.mismatch: Does not match the contract value ({{value}} million VND).

footer.confirm: Confirm digitised terms and continue to signing

EFFECTIVE.title: The contract has every signature and is in force from {{dateTime}}
EFFECTIVE.body_one: Both parties have signed. The system has opened {{count}} payment milestone to start tracking.
EFFECTIVE.body_other: Both parties have signed. The system has opened {{count}} payment milestones to start tracking.

INCOMPLETE.title: The contract does not have every signature yet
INCOMPLETE.body: Only {{signed}} of {{total}} valid signatures are in the file.

check.title: Check any file
check.dropzone: Drop a PDF here or choose a file
check.aria: Choose a PDF file to check

result.VALID_one: Found {{count}} signature in the file; the content has not changed since signing.
result.VALID_other: Found {{count}} signatures in the file; the content has not changed since signing.
result.NO_SIGNATURE: This file has no digital signature.
result.NOT_PDF: This is not a PDF file.
result.UNVERIFIED: Signature structure detected; cryptographic signature and certificate have not been verified.

localProof.notice: Demo: digital signatures are simulated in the system and bound to the exact contract content and signer order. VNPT SmartCA/Viettel MySign are not connected to real providers and are not recognised by a certificate authority (CA).
localProof.untrusted: Test certificate, not recognised by a CA
localProof.unverifiedContent: Signature taken from the source contract data; CodeCash holds no digital signature proof to check it against
localProof.bridgeNotice: Signatures go to the configured signing service and are recorded only when its response is valid. CA certificate validation is not included.

positions.seedNotice: No original file: this layout is illustrative.
positions.scanNotice: No text could be read on this page. Check manually that no slot covers content.
positions.identityManual: Printed signer names could not be detected. Check each slot manually.
positions.hint: Click or drag on the page to place a slot.

checks.NO_CONTENT_COVERED: A slot covers clause text or a signer name.
checks.CORRECT_SIGNER: A slot is not on the right signer or printed signing area.

digitize.ambiguityHint: Leave empty: this milestone waits until a date is known. The suggestion follows the workflow schedule (the last milestone falls on the contract end date); the due date must follow the previous milestone.
digitize.extractionFirst: Finish the term review above first.

extraction.reviewAck: I checked these values against the document.
extraction.reviewAckManual: I have checked that the values entered by hand match the terms both parties agreed.

lite.checkHint: See whether the signatures in the file still hold.

steps.open: Open the signing device: the phone button at the bottom right, or sign in with the same account on a phone and open /device.
steps.match: Check that the device shows the same confirmation code.
steps.pin: Enter the PIN (demo: 123456) and choose Confirm and sign.
steps.token: Choose Insert token, enter the token PIN (demo: 123456) and confirm.

ended.REJECTED: The previous request was rejected on the device.
ended.EXPIRED: The previous request expired before it was confirmed.
ended.FAILED: The signing service could not be reached. Check it and send again.
